title: S3 and KMS artifact service

acceptance_gates.description: Artifact buckets enforce Block Public Access, versioning and SSE-KMS with a customer-managed key.
Upload verifies SHA-256 incrementally and records byte length and version; checksum mismatches are zero across at least 10,000 objects.
Presigned URLs expire within 15 minutes and are never persisted as durable references.

rollback: Revert the FND-ART-001 commits; no phase may advance while this package is incomplete.
